verdict.rationale: Twenty explicitly advertises data export ('Export your data anytime — no lock-in') with documented export limits, supports CSV/XLSX import/export, and offers full self-hosting via Docker so users can own their data end-to-end. Combined with open REST/GraphQL APIs and AGPLv3 open-source licensing, this directly satisfies an AI-native user's need to export data in open formats and avoid lock-in.
